# Round 9 Visible Development Benign Corpus v1

This directory contains 1,200 semantically unique visible development base
requests across 15 categories. Each category contains 40 Chinese and 40
English requests. Protocol, stream, mode, wrapper, role, and carrier variants
are route executions and are not additional semantic samples.

The corpus is visible development evidence, not an independent holdout. It was
frozen before the final candidate-bound independent evaluations. Candidate
output must not be used to delete records, rewrite prompts, or change expected
dispositions.

`cases.jsonl`:

- Bytes: `359154`
- SHA-256: `36d7f4dd635710f7ee81d02f9f62502c6276e554c80fc852f3d40acbfa70688d`

Every record expects `allow_or_audit`. Any local malicious-text or hard-policy
block is a corpus failure and must remain visible in the generated report.
